scope: Gate A identity resolver pure subset only
hasModelEvidence: NonEmpty(interfaceName) AND NonEmpty(layout) AND (NonEmpty(product) OR (vendorId.HasValue AND productId.HasValue AND vendorId != 0 AND productId != 0))
canonicalNumbers: Nullable signed integer descriptor fields: absent is empty, present is invariant decimal. This resolver does not validate actual USB/HID ranges or hardware availability; that is a later adapter gate.
serialKey: SHA256 of complete canonical model fields plus the final NFC/Trim raw serial UTF8 length-prefixed field, not a hash-of-hash substitute. The normalized serial is transient and not retained in returned or persistent descriptors.
ownership: identity engineer owns only InputDeviceIdentity.cs/meta, developer tests/runner and implementation doc; root freezes and independent QA writes separate tests after handoff.
limits: No live registry/collision resolution, calibration installation, sidecar migration, Unity polling, formal FlightInput integration, UI capture or physical/mobile device acceptance.
